missingProject: Open a project before starting Blueprint AI.
missingProfile: Configure an AI provider before sending a message.
missingCredential: The selected provider does not have an API key.
errorNoOutput: The AI provider returned no text or tool call after five retries.
errorFormatLimit: The AI provider exceeded the tool format retry limit.
errorIterationLimit: The AI provider exceeded the 30-iteration workflow limit.
errorMissingApiKey: The selected provider does not have an API key.
BLUEPRINT_AI_API_KEY_UNCHANGED: Enter a new API key to replace it
BLUEPRINT_AI_INPUT_HINT: Ask about this Blueprint or describe a change. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line.
BLUEPRINT_AI_NO_BLUEPRINTS: The current project has no available Blueprints.
BLUEPRINT_AI_TARGET_LOCKED_HINT: Each conversation is permanently bound to one existing Blueprint.
BLUEPRINT_AI_DELETE_CONVERSATION_PROMPT: Delete this conversation and its local history?
BLUEPRINT_AI_TARGET_MISSING: The target Blueprint was deleted or renamed. This conversation is read-only; create a new one.
BLUEPRINT_AI_PROPOSAL_CONFLICT: The Blueprint changed after this proposal was created; current content was not overwritten.
